using UnityEngine;
namespace WalkingSkeleton.Tasks { public static class ScoreAccumulation { public static int Add(int score, int delta) { long total = (long)score + delta; if (total > int.MaxValue) return int.MaxValue; if (total < int.MinValue) return int.MinValue; return (int)total; } } }
